name: Investigate Echo Ridge
summary: Kobolds gather in force at Echo Ridge Mine, so Marshal McBride sends you north. The mine supplies ore and raw materials to Northshire Abbey and the Stormwind guard stationed there.

sections.title: A Deepening Infestation
sections.body: Scattered vermin have troubled the valley's forested edge near Northshire. Now the scouts report a more organized gathering. At the entrance, you face kobold workers and see how deeply they have settled into the mine.

sections.title: Threat to the Abbey's Wealth
sections.body: The kobolds have seized the tunnels and stopped the digging. Their presence strains the Northshire brotherhood's defenses. McBride asks you to cull ten workers, but the infestation reaches farther into the shafts than a surface patrol can reach.

faq.q: Who sends me on this mission?
faq.answer: Marshal McBride, commander of the Stormwind guards at Northshire Abbey, sends you north after scouts report kobolds gathering there.

faq.q: Where is the Echo Ridge Mine located?
faq.answer: Echo Ridge Mine lies in the far north of Northshire Valley, in the foothills above the abbey and its vineyards.

faq.q: Why are kobolds dangerous to Northshire?
faq.answer: Kobolds breed rapidly and swarm through underground tunnels in huge packs. Their hold on Echo Ridge Mine stops vital mining and threatens to overwhelm Northshire's undermanned valley.

faq.q: What happens after I defeat the workers outside?
faq.answer: When you return, Marshal McBride's worst suspicions are confirmed: the mine is thoroughly infested. He enlists your aid for a deeper push into the shafts in Skirmish at Echo Ridge.

faq.q: Why doesn't the Stormwind army clear the mine themselves?
faq.answer: With King Varian Wrynn missing and resources stretched thin across Elwynn and neighboring frontiers, Northshire's garrison is too small to spare full patrols for pest control. The guards rely on capable new recruits.

faq.q: What kind of kobolds are found around the mine entrance?
faq.answer: Kobold workers labor around the mine entrance and upper passages. They dig tunnels and gather candle wax for their underground colony.

angles.text: Copper from Echo Ridge Mine is essential to Northshire's smiths. Clearing its underground tunnels matters to miners' livelihoods.
Kobolds have reached close to Stormwind's spiritual heart in Northshire. Their presence shows the kingdom's vulnerability while its regular forces are stretched thin.
As a young human beginning service in Northshire Valley, defending Echo Ridge from underground pests gives you an early chance to prove your worth to the kingdom.
